# Internet Archive

> > A nonprofit digital library preserving billions of web pages, books, videos, software, and more through the Wayback Machine and open collections.

The Internet Archive provides free universal access to knowledge through web archiving, digitized books and media, and developer tools including REST APIs and command-line interfaces. Founded as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, it serves as a modern Library of Alexandria supporting UN Sustainable Development Goal #9.

## Key Topics

- Wayback Machine
- Internet Archive
- archive.org
- web archiving
- digital library

- Internet Archive Command-line Tool

- Library of Alexandria
- GDPR compliance

## Getting Started

- [Internet Archive Help Center](https://help.archive.org): Main help center hub for Internet Archive support and documentation
- [About Internet Archive](https://blog.archive.org/about): About Internet Archive: 501(c)(3) nonprofit with Wayback Machine & collections
- [Internet Archive General Information](https://help.archive.org/help/internet-archive-general-information): Nonprofit status, donations, cryptocurrency, and research assistance info
- [Archive.org Information](https://help.archive.org/help/archive-org-information): Archive.org collections significance, fees, GDPR compliance, and settings
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://help.archive.org/help/frequently-asked-questions): FAQ about donating physical items and condition requirements

## Wayback Machine

- [Wayback Machine General Information](https://help.archive.org/help/wayback-machine-general-information): FAQ about Wayback Machine web archiving service and capture sources
- [Wayback Machine Advanced Search](https://archive.org/web/web-advancedsearch.php): Advanced search interface for Wayback Machine URL and date filtering

## Developer Resources & API

- [API Documentation & Developer Resources](https://archive.org/help): API documentation, REST API, embedding guides, and developer resources
- [Downloading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide): Guide to downloading files from Internet Archive using wget and CLI tools

## Special Programs

- [Offline Archive](https://archive.org/about/offline-archive): Offline Archive program for Internet-In-A-Box and developing countries

## Optional

- [All About Eve (1950)](https://archive.org/details/all.-about.-eve.-1950.720p): Classic 1950 film by Joseph L. Mankiewicz starring Bette Davis
- [The Conspirators' Hierarchy: The Committee of 300](https://archive.org/details/committee300): Book by John Coleman on Committee of 300 conspiracy theory
- [The Book of Inkscape](https://archive.org/details/bookofinkscapede0000kirs): Comprehensive guide to Inkscape vector graphics editor by Dmitry Kirsanov
- [OoT: Reverse Bottle Adventure Guide](https://archive.org/details/youtube-lt0n-qRLLJA): Ocarina of Time speedrun glitch tutorial by SnipinG117
- [Solar Hydroponic System Tutorial](https://archive.org/details/a-tutorial-guide-for-operating-hydroponic-system-using-solar-energy): Tutorial on solar-powered hydroponic agriculture systems
- [Digital Logic Introduction](https://archive.org/details/manualzilla-id-5706760): Archived manual introducing digital logic concepts from Manualzilla
